LLM_PROVIDER.description: The LLM provider to use. Can be 'ollama' or 'openai'.

OLLAMA_MODEL.description: The model name to use when LLM_PROVIDER is set to 'ollama'.

OPENAI_MODEL.description: The model name to use when LLM_PROVIDER is set to 'openai'.

OPENAI_API_KEY.description: The API key required for OpenAI when LLM_PROVIDER is set to 'openai'.

OLLAMA_BASE_URL.description: The base URL for the Ollama local LLM backend.

UPLOAD_MAX_FILES.description: The maximum number of files allowed per assessment upload.

CHROMA_PERSIST_DIR.description: The absolute or relative path to the directory where the Chroma vector database will persist its data.

UPLOAD_MAX_FILE_SIZE_MB.description: The maximum allowed file size for document uploads in megabytes.
